Initialize: the best strategy  \( O_{I,J}^{*} \)  for all U2B and U2U links, sharing state  \( \rho_{j}^{i}=0 \) .
for i=1:I
    for j=1:J
    \( L_{j}= \)  Descending Sort of  \( (U_{j}^{i}) \) ;
    \( L_{i}= \)  Descending Sort of  \( (U_{i}) \) ;
    \( L_{i}^{matched}= \)  Sort of  \( (U_{i}*\rho_{j}^{i}) \)  for  \( (U_{i}*\rho_{j}^{i})!=0; \) 
 \( n_{i}=B_{i}/b_{RB}; \) 
While  \( A_{j}=\sum_{i=1}^{I}\rho_{j}^{i}==0 \)  do
    \( U2U_{j} \)  request RBs from the highest ranked  \( U2B_{i} \)  in
    \( L_{j}; \) 
    If  \( n_{i}\geq n_{j}^{i}+2*nf_{j}^{i} \)  then
    \( \rho_{j}^{i}=1; \) 
    \( n_{i}=n_{i}-n_{j}^{i}-2*nf_{j}^{i}; \) 
else
    For  \( a=1:\sum_{j=1}^{J}\rho_{j}^{i} \) 
    \( a=Rank(L_{i}^{matched}(U2U_{k})) \) ;
    If  \( Rank(L_{i}(U2U_{j}))\geq Rank(L_{i}(U2U_{k})) \) 
    \( \|n_{i}+n_{k}^{i}+2*nf_{k}^{i}\geq n_{j}^{i}+2*nf_{j}^{i} \)  then
    \( \rho_{j}^{i}=1; \) 
    \( \rho_{k}^{i}=0; \) 
    \( n_{i}=n_{i}-n_{j}^{i}-2*nf_{j}^{i}+n_{k}^{i}+2*nf_{k}^{i}; \) 
    delete  \( U2B_{i} \)  from  \( L_{k}; \) 
    else
    delete  \( U2B_{i} \)  from  \( L_{j}; \) 
    \( L_{i}^{matched}= \)  Sort of  \( (U_{i}*\rho_{j}^{i}) \)  for  \( (U_{i}*\rho_{j}^{i})!=0; \) 
return  \( \rho_{j}^{i}; \)
